summary: The --controller and --target options are composite alternatives to --docker, --remote and --venv for more flexible setups; the shell command uses three platform-specific options instead of --target.
questions: How do I run the controller and target in different environments with ansible-test?

answer_card.title: Composite environment options
answer_card.answer_md: For setups the simple options can't express, use `--controller` and `--target` instead of `--docker`, `--remote` or `--venv`. With the `shell` command, `--target` is replaced by three platform-specific options. Run your command with `--help` for details.
